title: measuretwice assessment (v0)
description: Typed measurement returned by one evaluator execution. An absent optional field was not measured. Never invent a missing measurement. The run report records the binding identity next to the assessment.

label.description: Selected answer label. Present when kind is categorical.

value.description: Selected answer for a binary question. Present when kind is binary.

level.description: Selected scale level. Present when kind is ordered.

position.description: Reported position along the ordered levels. Fractional values stay unrounded. Optional when kind is ordered.

distribution.description: Probability mass by answer or level, when the evaluator reports it. Names must match the check answers or levels. Masses must sum to one. A distribution is a measurement input, not a calibrated probability of correctness.

confidence.description: Confidence reported by the provider. Absent when the evaluator has no confidence field. Distinct from measured correctness.

reference.description: Stable reference inside the named input.

evidence.description: Evidence selected by the evaluator. Each input must be in the using list of the check. Absent when the evaluator returns none.
